laws.rule: National park entry (general rate, which applies to foreign visitors), daily pass from 1 June 2026: El Palmar ARS 25,000. Children 0 to 6 free. Flexipass 3- and 7-day passes are also sold. (No RBA rate for ARS; at the Banco Central de la República Argentina rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 1,078.2486 ARS: ARS 25,000 ≈ A$23.19)
